def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    p=None; g=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']<=10:
            b=n['boundary']; p=(min(x[0] for x in b),min(x[1] for x in b))
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; g.append((min(x[0] for x in b),min(x[1] for x in b)))
    return p, sorted(g)
print("before", state())

print("after LEFT", state())

print("after MOUSE", state(), "changed", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), "done", last_action_result.get('done'), "lvl", current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
